# Verity — visual asset placement

Copy the PNGs into `.github/assets/` in your repository. These assets are promotional illustrations; the studio and floating-mode panels are **conceptual mockups**, not screenshots.

```md
<p align="center">
  <img src=".github/assets/01-hero.png" alt="Verity — expressive desktop companion" width="100%" />
</p>

## A face with range
<img src=".github/assets/02-motion-atlas.png" alt="Verity motion atlas: 721 registered behaviors, 15 reference expressions, 16 motion groups" width="100%" />
<img src=".github/assets/10-expression-studies.png" alt="Illustrative expression studies" width="100%" />

## Tune the personality
<img src=".github/assets/03-motion-studio.png" alt="Conceptual art for Verity motion studio" width="100%" />

## Voice and presence
<img src=".github/assets/04-voice.png" alt="Verity voice and lip movement" width="100%" />
<img src=".github/assets/07-floating-mode.png" alt="Conceptual illustration of floating companion mode" width="100%" />

## Optional Hermes connection
<img src=".github/assets/05-hermes.png" alt="Optional Hermes Gateway integration" width="100%" />

## Choose your model
<img src=".github/assets/06-providers.png" alt="Configurable chat provider options" width="100%" />
```

`08-social-preview.png` can serve as repository social sharing artwork (upload it under GitHub repository Settings → General → Social preview). `09-section-divider.png` can be used sparingly to separate long sections.

This asset pack was based on the public repository README as viewed on 2026-11-05. Feature statements reflect that README; models and optional integrations may change. Your wordmark was preserved from the supplied PNG.
